actors.name: Péter Magyar
actors.blurb: Magyar is driving the news cycle with his aggressive push to reshape Hungary’s top institutions. In the last 48 hours he has demanded the resignation of President Tamás Sulyok and other senior officials, threatened constitutional amendments to remove them if they refuse, and showcased lavish spending at the central bank to justify anti-corruption probes. His actions have sparked intense debate about democratic backsliding and the rule of law in Hungary.
